notes.title: Version 1.8 - Introducing Custom Study Sets
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope everyone is doing well.

[h2]Custom Study Sets[/h2]
In this update, you can now build and play your own [b]custom study sets[/b] to help with your learning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084542/68b9ea236cd8fc97b9a219aba00468b6a171870b.png[/img]
[h3]Where you can access your custom sets[/h3]
As of this update, you can access the UI panel to add/view/edit custom sets through [b]2 ways[/b]:
1.) [b]Main Menu[/b] -> [b]Dictionary[/b] -> [b]Your custom curated sets[/b]
2.) [b]Main Menu[/b] -> [b]Play[/b] (opens the level selection menu) -> [b]Build / Play Custom Study Sets[/b]

[h3]What a custom set contains[/h3]
For each custom study set, you'll be able to name the custom set anything you like, provide an optional description to give more context, and add words. For a word, you can provide romaji, kana, kanji, and a definition. Romaji and kana are required. A custom set also requires a unique ID.

Make sure that you [b]save[/b] so your custom sets are consistent between play sessions!

You can delete any words from a custom set or delete a custom set entirely. Deleting a custom set will automatically save to reflect the changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084542/31985918ec26bc79af18dd83c3d236c9d967ba16.png[/img]
[h3]Playing a custom set[/h3]
Playing a custom set can be done by pressing the [b]Build / Play Custom Study Sets[/b] button in the level selection menu. You'll be able to add, view, and edit custom sets here as you would within the Dictionary menu. Here, the only additional step is to click a valid custom set to play and select configurations at the bottom of the screen.

[h2]Other changes in this update[/h2]
- Fixed a bug where the Level Review display did not show successful/unsuccessful words typed when playing special game modes like Customize Your Own Level.

- Added an additional menu after clicking on the Dictionary button in the main menu to help with the user experience.

I hope you will find this feature useful and feel free to reach out if you experience any bugs.

Thanks for playing

notes.title: Version 1.7.1 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here is a small update. Let me know if you run into any issues.

What's changed:
[list]
[*] Added another extra configuration setting to adjust the size of the definition text

[*] You can now drag the Kana Combo UI text anywhere on the screen in the case that the text blocks any enemy text

Note that the position placement will be[b] saved for that specific map upon level completion or by going to the main menu mid-game via the pause menu[/b] (this is where saving logic is called) so that you won’t have to move it again if you play the same map again.

[*] Added some UI changes to give more info and clarity about some stuff
[/list]
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.7 - Level Completion Times and Customizable Enemy Text Font Size
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are doing well. Here is a small update.

What's changed:
[list]
[*] [b]Level Completion Times[/b] - you can now see the duration it took to complete a level as well as your personal best time for that level. This will be shown in minutes and seconds (for example: 2 min 34.56 sec). The time will be displayed in the Level Review window after winning a level.

[*] [b]Customizable Enemy Text Font Size[/b] - you can now set the font size of enemy text to suit your liking. This can be accessed in the Extra Configs menu which can be navigated to by doing: Pause Menu -> Settings -> Extra Configs.

[*] Fixed some display issues with Katakana levels.
[/list]
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.6 - Vocab Dictionaries, Resetting Input Field, New Shop Item, and more
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here is another update based on some feedback. I am still working on implementing some suggestions which will be released next update. If you run into any bugs or have any suggestions, please let me know, thanks.

The changelog:
[list]
[*] [b]Vocabulary Dictionaries for JLPT, Kana Blitz, and Kanji Blitz[/b] - You can now view all vocab words used in these game modes. There is an input field where you can enter romaji to search for specific words. 

[i]I have also updated the Typed Vocabulary Dictionary within the Kana Dictionary section to be similar to the layout of the previously mentioned dictionaries. This will help with performance as your typed vocab dictionary grows in size.[/i]

[*]  Added a new item called [b]Life Saver[/b] - Upon activation, immediately gain 3 lives

[*]  [b]2 New Customizable Extra Configuration Settings![/b] - Some of you suggested these to improve your experience. You can navigate to the Extra Config Settings by going: [i]Pause Menu -> Settings -> Extra Configs[/i]

[i][b]Customizable Definition Text Color[/b][/i] - There is now a color picker you can open to choose any color you want. There are multiple options to pick from such as using the eyedropper tool, inputting RGB values, or inputting hex codes.

[i][b]Toggle Option to Reset Input Field when inputting incorrect romaji[/b][/i] - By default, this option will be deselected and will only apply to the default input system, Romaji Match.

[*] Added a [b]new achievement[/b]: [i]Token Collector[/i] (Earn 500 tokens)

[*] Fixed a bug where popup text would be an English definition instead of kana when eliminating enemies in Definition Mode

[*] Added a small set of new vocab words for some main levels

[*] Additional UI updates to increase clarity and consistency
[/list]

Thanks for playing the game!

notes.title: Version 1.5 - Stunning Enemies, New Kana Audio Clip Option, New Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Happy new year! I hope everyone had a happy holidays. Here is a new update to help with your Japanese learning.

Here is the changelog:
[list]
[*] A new item has been added to the in-game shop called [b]Stun Enemies[/b]. At the time of item activation, it will set all enemies’ movement speed to 0 for 4 seconds. 

[i]Do note that you cannot have Slow Enemies and Stun Enemies active at the same time.[/i]

[*]  For levels 1 - 17, you can now choose to hear the kana pronunciations when eliminating enemies in the first few waves that have singular kana to learn for that specific level to help with memorization. For example, pronunciation clips can play on an enemy's death if the kana they contain is either あ, い, う, え, or お for level 1 or か, き, く, げ, or ご for level 2. 

There will be a toggle option located in the initial kana slides when entering a level. By default, the option will not be selected.

[*]  Added 2 new achievements: [i]Kana Seito[/i] and [i]The First Purchase[/i]

[*] Updated the user interface to reduce clutter for the Vocabulary Dictionary when viewing previously typed words. Long definition text will now be truncated but you can hover over them with your mouse to see the full text.

[*] Minor UI updates to increase clarity and consistency
[/list]
If you have any issues/bugs or any feedback/suggestions, please let me know. Consider sharing the game with others if you find the game helpful. Thanks!

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 - Viewing Previously Typed Vocabulary Words
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Here is a new feature based on some feedback. Let me know if you run into any bugs or have any suggestions. Thanks for playing and I hope your Japanese learning journey is going well!

Here is what's changed:
[list]
[*] [b]Viewing Typed Vocabulary Words[/b] - Located in the Kana Dictionary screen (accessed from the Main Menu), you can now see all of the vocabulary words you have typed going forward. Any Japanese words with an attached definition will be added to the list. This applies for levels 1 - 17, Kana Blitz, Kanji Blitz, and Customize Your Own Levels.

[*]  Fixed a bug where leaving a level while having items currently active such as Slow Enemies would result in not being able to activate any items again.

[*]  Fixed a bug regarding the Romaji Snap Match input system where the text in the input field box would not correctly update or reset when typing a correct letter.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 - Word Definitions for Levels 1-17

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - Level Review, Displaying Furigana Option, and Definition Mode
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Sorry for the late update. I was in Japan for 2 weeks in Tokyo and Osaka which was extremely fun. Highly recommend visiting the country! Food was great and people were extremely respectful.

This update aims to add some features some of you guys recommended. This update did result in a lot of internal restructuring so if you experience any bugs, errors, or just have any future ideas, let me know. Thanks for playing!

Here is the changelog:
[list]
[*] [b]Post Level Review[/b] - After each level victory (excluding endless modes like [i]Kana Blitz[/i]), you’ll be able to see what words/characters you were able to correctly type and the ones you have missed. You’ll be assigned a letter grade based on your performance ranging from [b][i]S[/i][/b] (the best) to [i][b]F[/b][/i] (the worst).
[*] [b]Definition Mode[/b] - In this new game mode option, the Japanese and definition displays are flipped! You’ll be shown the definitions of words and you have to type the corresponding Japanese translation. For example, an enemy might spawn with the word [b][i]red[/i][/b] and you have to type [i][b]aka[/b][/i]. Definitely select this game mode option if you want to challenge yourself!

This option has been added to [i]Kana’s Customize Your Own Level[/i], [i]Kanji Corner’s Customize Your Own Level[/i], [i]Kana Blitz[/i], [i]Kanji Blitz[/i], and [i]JLPT Practice[/i].

[*] [b]The Display Furigana Option[/b] - You can now choose if you want to view furigana for Kanji enemies. Toggle this option to choose between showing hiragana subtext above the kanji and strictly only showing kanji.

This option has been added to all Kanji-related game modes: [i]Kanji Corner’s Customize Your Own Level[/i], [i]Kanji Blitz[/i], and [i]JLPT Practice[/i].

[*] [b]A Few Quality of Life changes for the UI and Map Environment have been made[/b]
[/list]
For the next update, I plan on adding a feature where you can make a list of Japanese characters/words you want to practice. You should be able to save it locally so that you can retrieve it anytime to play, update, or delete it.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Here is a small update to improve the experience of playing the game. Let me know if you run into any bugs or have any suggestions.

[b]Whats Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]ぢ and づ have been added to the Kana Dictionary and can now be typed[/b]
[list]
[*]To be consistent with the Windows Input Method Editor (IME), type [i]di[/i] for ぢ and [i]du[/i] for づ
[/list]
[*][b]For the default Input System (Romaji Match), typing is now very similar to inputting in a regular input field.[/b] 
[list]
[*]All the commands (using the arrow keys to move the caret to a certain character or using CTRL + A to select all text) can now be done
[/list]
[*][b]Definition Popups' Display Time and Vertical Speed can now be set by you in the Extra Configs panel within the Settings Menu[/b] 
[list]
[*]The default display time has also been increased from 0.75 seconds to 1.25 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]All information within Extra Configs can now be saved locally so that it will be consistent across play sessions on your device[/b]
[/list]
For the next update, I plan on implementing a post-level review feature where you can see your stats after a level as well as some additional gameplay options for custom levels.

Thanks for playing!
